# API Documentation for the Admin Dashboard

## GET /examples

Retrieve a collection of example entries.


{:.no_toc}
### Required Parameters

* **author_id** (_Integer_) - Identifier of an author
* **title** (_String_) - Title of the book

{:.no_toc}
### Optional Parameters

* **highlight** (_Boolean_) - Show only highlighted examples.

{:.no_toc}
### JSON Response Fields

* **examples** (_Array_) - The collection of examples.
* **examples[].id** (_Integer_) - The id of that example.
* **examples[].title** (_String_) - The title of that example.
* **examples[].text** (_String_) - The text of that example.
* **examples[].highlight** (_String_) - Information if the example is highlighted.

{:.no_toc}
### Example Response

```json
{
  "examples": [{
    "id":1,
    "title":"Animals",
    "text":"Dogs and cats are some.",
    "highlight":true
  }]
}
```
